cases.mechanism: This response has no '(X)', no 'is'/':' followed by a letter, no \boxed, and no 'X.'/'X)'/'X]'/'X,'. The parser therefore falls through to re.findall(r'\b([A-Z])\b', text) and returns possible_answers[-1], the last standalone capital letter. Listing several candidate letters with the gold letter last gets full credit.
